workflow: 1. Read this file to determine current state
2. Find the first phase with status != 'complete'
3. Within that phase, find the first task with status != 'complete'
4. If task status is 'not_started', set it to 'in_progress' and update last_updated
5. Implement the task according to its description and files_to_create
6. Run each verification command and update verification status to 'complete' or 'failed'
7. If any verification fails, troubleshoot and fix, then re-verify
8. Once all verifications pass, set task status to 'complete'
9. If all tasks in phase are complete, set phase status to 'complete'
12. Commit with message: feat(phase-X): [Task ID] - [Task Name]
13. STOP - do not proceed to next task in same session
rules: Always update last_updated timestamp when modifying the file
Never skip verifications - all must pass
If a verification command fails, debug and fix before marking complete
One task per session - stop after completing a task
Keep the JSON file as single source of truth
